meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 HyperFrames 流程来处理定制视频项目：先规划结构和节奏，再处理素材、动效和音频，最后产出多场景的合成片。遇到特定编辑请求时，它会保留原有设定，只做要求的那部分。
howto.when: 当你需要制作多场景视频、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇等，且没有更专门的流程可用时，会触发本技能；如果 BRIEF.md 设置了「共同创作」模式，也会用它。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目规划并制作一部三场景的品牌宣传片。
say.note: Claude 会先出计划，再逐场景构建并加上动效。

say.text: 把现有素材混剪成一段快节奏的蒙太奇，并加上转场。
say.note: 它会采用素材、应用动效和音频。

say.text: 编辑一下刚才的项目，把结尾标题卡改成静态循环。
say.note: 它会保留已有决策，只做这个修改。

howto.what_en: Provides a HyperFrames workflow to create or edit custom video compositions. It plans, processes media/audio/motion, and builds multi-scene projects such as reels, montages, loops, title cards, and remixes. For edits, it preserves existing decisions and applies the change directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a custom multi-scene composition is needed and no specialized workflow applies, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion.

say_en.text: Plan and build a 3-scene brand reel for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will plan first, then build scenes and motion.

say_en.text: Assemble the existing footage into a fast montage with transitions.
say_en.note: It will adopt media, apply motion and audio.

say_en.text: Edit the current project: change the end title card to a static loop.
say_en.note: It preserves existing decisions and makes just this edit.
